slides.title: A note anyone can read
slides.text: Mina passes a plain note in class, and anyone who finds it can read every word. Some messages need more than paper to stay private.
slides.alt: A note to send: OAK TREE, readable by anyone. Three scrambled readings wait below; only one uses the shift of 5.

focus.cue: The message to send, in plain words anyone could read
The same message, scrambled three ways

slides.title: Turn the cipher wheel
slides.text: A cipher wheel shifts every letter by the same number. Shift by 3, and A becomes D, so a plain word turns into a secret one.
slides.alt: The cipher wheel: turn the key and every letter shifts, turning a plain message into a secret one.

focus.cue: Turn the inner wheel until the reading makes sense
The secret message, and the reading under it

slides.title: Only the key can read it
slides.text: A friend with the same shift of 3 can turn the letters back and read the note. Computers scramble messages the same way but with much bigger keys, and the padlock on a message does this too.
slides.alt: A secret word, DAOWQF, with no shift marked on the card. Only trying the wheel will show what it says.

focus.cue: A secret word with an unknown shift: turn one step at a time
The wheel turns the scramble back into a word

slides.title: Codes are for privacy
slides.text: Secret codes are for keeping messages private, not for being sneaky. Never use a code to hide an unkind message about someone else.
slides.alt: A note to send: OAK TREE, readable by anyone. Three scrambled readings wait below; only one uses the shift of 5.

focus.cue: First the plain message, out in the open
The wheel scrambles it before it travels

slides.title: A scrambled note
slides.text: This morning, the post sack held a note written in a scramble. Only the Magpie can read it, and Pim wonders what shiny secret it is hiding.
slides.alt: A secret word, DAOWQF, with no shift marked on the card. Only trying the wheel will show what it says.

focus.cue: A note written in a scramble: DAOWQF

words.means: a way to turn a message into a secret code
the secret setting, like shift by 3, that locks and unlocks a code
to mix up letters so a message cannot be read
letters or symbols that stand for a hidden message

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Secret Messages and crack the wheel levels. Use the key on the wheel to turn scrambled letters back into words.
slides.alt: The cipher wheel: turn the key and every letter shifts, turning a plain message into a secret one.
